format_string: Unsupported instruction '%s' used when compiling for '%s' target architecture
Modifier '%s' on instruction '%s' %s is not supported starting %s and later architectures
Instruction '%s' with '%s' is not supported starting from PTX ISA version %s
Instruction '%s' without '.sync' is not supported on .target sm_70 and higher from PTX ISA version 6.4
Pragma '%s' not supported on %s, will be ignored.
Option '%s' not supported for gpu architecture '%s'
Per-function compilation not supported for gpu architecture '%s'
Target architecture not defined at start of file '%s'
Instruction '%s' requires SM 1.3 or higher, or map_f64_to_f32 directive
32-Bit ABI (--machine 32 or 32-Bit addressing) is not supported on %s or higher architectures.
